notes.title: No More Bugs, Just Loot! 🚀 Danger Scavenger Update is Here!
notes.notes:
🚀 Danger Scavenger Update is LIVE! 🚀
[build #2.10.0]

Hey, Scavengers! We know it’s been a while since the last update, but trust us - we’ve been hard at work, fighting bugs like they’re rogue A.I. minions trying to take over the skyline. This update is all about squashing those frustrating glitches and ensuring your scavenging adventures are as smooth as Tru’s hammer swing. So, what’s new? We're glad you asked!

🏍️ Bike Drama Be Gone!
For some players, pulling up to a new building ready to smash some bots turned into an unplanned bike ride - stuck and going nowhere. Awkward. Well, not anymore! We've fixed it, so you can dismount like a pro and get straight to scavenging. No more "perma-bike" moments to slow you down.

🛠️ Workshop Woes? Not Anymore!
Previously, if you dared to move during the victory cutscene, the workshop wouldn't open. That’s like being stuck in a hardware store with the doors locked. But not anymore! The workshop is now ready for action, no matter how wiggly you are. Build, craft, and prep for your next mission without a hitch.

💥 Runtime Error? We’re on it! Ah, the infamous Runtime Error C++... it’s like that boss that just won’t stay down. We’ve located one of its hideouts and dealt some severe damage. While we’re sure we’ve reduced its appearances, we’re still looking for ghostly glitches that might try to respawn. If you see one, you know what to do - report it, and we’ll send the Scavenger squad after it.

🎉 We’re Listening - And We Care
We’ve read your reviews. We’ve seen the pain points. And we’re doing something about it. We’re fully committed to giving you the best possible Danger Scavenger experience. You deserve a fast, fun, and fluid ride, and we’re ensuring you get it.

That’s it for now, but stay tuned - more to come. Remember, we’re always watching (in a friendly, non-A.I. way) and constantly improving.

BE A REBEL! ✊Star Drifters team ⭐🚀

notes.title: Star Drifters recap #2 🚀
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/ce120de2b04e5ae22f7e23aa739c7c68d6082dfa.png[/img]

Hello everyone! 👋

The year 2022 is now a melody of the past.
We would like to thank all of you guys for supporting us since day one! 🙏

Without further ado - let’s check out what happened in our camp during the second half of ‘22. Let’s go! 🏃‍♂️

[h2]⚒️ First Dwarf (...and some gaming events here and there! 🎮)[/h2]

In case you missed it - First Dwarf is [b]our upcoming Action RPG set in the world of Driftland[/b]. That’s why you can read about it on Driftland: The Magic Revival Steam card.

You’ll be able to pet a good boi in the game. Mhm. That’s right! 🐕

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/2291dda4316057dd3f8a5dd9c95a3dfaa99cb714.png[/img]

Now, let’s talk about the asymmetrical co-op 🐉 that we’re implementing in First Dwarf.

[img]https://media1.giphy.com/media/72TI5I4dhzpNY9lM9M/giphy.gif?cid=790b7611ccbf33c850aabc58ee4639c1cad792f6f0e8cd80&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

[b]🧑‍🤝‍🧑 In co-op[/b], players will be able to take control over the mech or one of its pilots: Tru or Ragna. Each of them has its own, separate skills to develop and upgrade. All characters have their strengths and weaknesses so it’s important to choose the characters wisely when preparing to complete certain tasks.

[b]🧑‍ In a single-player game[/b], the player can switch between characters, completing tasks with the one with better skills in a given field. Tru, Ragna, and the Mech will have different skill trees. Tru will be a better Mecha pilot, Ragna can e.g. fly, and the Mech can be treated as a kind of armored vehicle, so without a pilot it will not work.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/c33ff6eb2732f53b648d63ea4d3f2deece9099f4.png[/img]

It’s important to say that implementing the asymmetrical co-op would not be possible without the [b]Game Prototype Design Competition 2022[/b] in which we were awarded! 🏆

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/96151434e644ea6a3661c55b5de7d2018f85f72c.jpg[/img]

The competition mentioned above helped us create some new mechanics for First Dwarf. Those mechanics evolved into a full-fledged, asymmetrical co-op mode of the game, which we implemented in its build! Once again, thank you to the co-organizers of the competition: Ministry of Culture and National Heritage of Poland, Centrum GovTech Poland, and CRPK, as well as Copernicus Game Jam 2022 - during which the diplomas 📜 were handed over and everyone who supported us along the way. 

We showed our upcoming action RPG at many gaming 🎮 events, both digital and held in “real” places. Just to name a few:
- [b]PAX West;[/b]
- Poznań Games Arena ([b]PGA[/b]);
- [b]Indie Cade[/b];
- [b]DreamHack Beyond Indie Showcase[/b];
- [b]MIX Next 2022[/b];
- [b]Dev.Play[/b];
- [b]#PitchYaGame[/b].

It’s time to focus on 3️⃣ of them. 

[h2]🚏 First stop  - PAX West. [/h2]

Lots of you came to our booth to check out an early build of our game. Thank you for that! See you next year! 🤜🤛

Your reactions surpassed our expectations, and the feedback provided will certainly influence the further development of the game, already at this stage. It was 4 days full of interesting conversations, laughter and a unique atmosphere created by countless players, cosplayers, journalists, or industry representatives.🤝

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/928de1dd561f0477b0514cba94e17747378edf6e.jpg[/img]

[h2]🚏 Second stop - Poznań Games Arena (PGA).[/h2]

In Poznań, we were showing First Dwarf, Scorchlands, Brewpub Simulator, and Lumencraft. PGA was such a blast! We felt your enjoyment brought to your faces by our upcoming games. Just look at Kuba, one of the members of our team - his smile does not lie 😊

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/43b9e42e2687c21e624f24477350e8b8d03887e2.png[/img]

[h2]🚏 The last stop - Dev.Play.[/h2]

It’s a yearly celebration of indie games and their developers. Game creators from all over the world come to Bucharest to present their titles and experiences. The event ended with an award gala. [b]First Dwarf received 3 awards: Best Game of the Show, Best Visuals, and Most Popular Game.[/b] 🏆 Thank y’all! 🙏

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/d62bed11cbef9823c12ab7d5bdd4e8ee557cdeb0.jpg[/img]

To wrap up the First Dwarf chapter of this recap we want to write about the key role of our IGN - Exclusive Announcement Trailer posted on IGN’s YouTube channel was viewed more than 285k times. There are also more than 5.4k thumbs up 👍 under the video! 📺

[previewyoutube=ZKC-fx7Vl88;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714900/First_Dwarf/

[h2]🐦 Scorchlands[/h2]

Who won’t fall in love with birdlike Giwis, running around through the hexes? The game’s a wholesome and adorable city builder.

[img]https://media1.giphy.com/media/XGAo3gKe9wJPDmwRMi/giphy.gif?cid=790b76115356d922e1b3d55f775e11e3307688c468f38669&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

Play the demo version - is available for free here, on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1090100/Scorchlands/

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/1fd3fa564ef3e26c57206c5fd6954b37f5eb4c47.png[/img]

At this point, we can say that developers from Ringlab ⚗️ are aiming for publishing more Steam News about in-game mechanics. When we’re writing these words, three of them are available as we speak: How the protagonist Giwi hatched, How to build your colony, and Gameplay Insight #1: Summoning the Nexus.

Stay tuned ! More of them will be published during January and February of 2023.

Also, the game received a warm welcome during #TurnBasedFest 2022! 😎

[h2]🕷️ Lumencraft[/h2]

The full release of this unique mix of a top-down shooter with base building and roguelike mechanisms is just around the corner! Nonetheless, we’re not spoiling the release date at the moment. That’s not the only great news - something big is coming to the game. We bet you weren’t expecting this. Jump on the hype train, but stay calm. For now, let’s go down. Together. ⏬

[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/WnnTLWpE7w6uV8RdOZ/giphy.gif[/img]

The developers from 2Dynamic Games are constantly tweaking and upgrading the game’s build. You can help them by completing the survey they made - we’ll be very grateful for the feedback! It’s called Discord 🎧 survey, because the game’s community was the first one to answer the questions mentioned in it.

👉 Link to Lumencraft survey: [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSckMJ-2HMumj5rPd_i2Up0bxT3CRyQvZzWpmKmvBQTfKDTLNg/viewform]https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSckMJ-2HMumj5rPd_i2Up0bxT3CRyQvZzWpmKmvBQTfKDTLNg/viewform[/url]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/9473fa44bdee56b1b582414221b127704082baf4.png[/img]

One of the most important moments during the Early Access of Lumencraft was taking a different approach to the game's build. The experimental update published a few months ago left the beta stage. It's now living its new life - the developers called it Giga Update. 

Lumencraft is reshaping every once in a while - two bigger updates and one smaller update were released since the release of [b]Giga Update[/b]. There’s a lot of fresh content in the game - you should play it now, especially if you spent some time with Lumencraft a few months ago. It truly is worth revisiting! 🔁

[h2]🍻 Brewpub Simulator[/h2]

There was a first, official playtest of the game - we’re glad how many of you decided to check out what it’s like to run a virtual pub and brew some virtual ale! A playable build of the game was presented to European audiences for the first time during [b]PGA 2022[/b]. Thanks for playing it, we know what works and what needs some tweaking here and there! 🍺

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/ffab0e73146aaa9b580a0e7165fbeccbcd7cc745.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1755180/Brewpub_Simulator/

[h2]🏢 Danger Scavenger [/h2]

Our skyscraper roguelite shooter is out now on Epic Games Store! 🎉

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/cf33bb6ae85f37b45f39d459367dd2249cf56bf8.png[/img]

[b]Just a reminder - Danger Scavenger is available on PC, PS4, XONE, Nintendo Switch, Atari VCS, and XSX. It’s also a Steam Deck verified game - give it a try on one of the handhelds, and you’ll fall in love with this fast-paced gunslinger action! [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1169740/Danger_Scavenger/

This is not the last word we said speaking about publishing our games’ catalog on Epic Games Store - more titles will follow soon. At this point, you can wishlist First Dwarf ⚒️ and Scorchlands 🐦 on this platform! 

That’s all for today.
Great things are here, but also great things are yet to come.
2023 will be ours! 

Don’t forget to support IndieDev! 🕹️

Much love, 
Star Drifters 🚀

notes.title: Star Drifters recap
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/37547bab3d30a82d7db45227a874bfff4b8d5fde.png[/img]

Hello everyone, 👋

you probably wonder why there’s a graphic with a screen taken from the Nintendo Switch 🎮 version of Danger Scavenger. The answer is simple - we wanted to make an announcement summarizing our work done between January and July of 2022 - when we’re writing these words, Driftland is still our most popular franchise. 🌲

Unfortunately, nothing really happened during this period in Driftland camp. Nonetheless, you can get the game in many discounts that pop up every once in a while (usually during Steam/GOG offers/events). But, y’know, there’s always something cookin’. ♨ Be patient.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/2f8424598909bae3c60b575fc912d21ea396a31e.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/718650/Driftland_The_Magic_Revival/

[h1]Danger Scavenger[/h1]

That’s where the fun starts. First of all - we’re flattered that DS is featured on the back of the [b]Atari VCS box[/b]. Ta-da! 🎉

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/68ec192ba36b75171cc891d762706687b362de7d.png[/img]

When [b]Steam Deck [/b]was on its way, we did everything to make sure that the game would run perfectly on the “second” handheld from day one. After that, we received an official Steam Deck verification in May. Speaking about the “first” handheld, just a reminder - [b]Danger Scavenger[/b] is available on [b]PC, PS4, XONE, Switch, VCS[/b] and [b]XSX[/b]. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1169740/Danger_Scavenger/

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/c15dfd345141b02b9005abd96832472137d76cb0.jpg[/img]

We’re always looking for new ways of approaching the titles that we already published. When we started talking with the [b]Tilt Five[/b] team, we knew that their [b]Holographic Gaming System[/b] would be a great place for a skyscraper-based roguelike. That’s why we made a dedicated [b]DLC [/b]to bring the catchphrase “a new level of the 3D vibrant holographic environment" to DS rooftops! 🌆

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/ed22b76333715d0e33298d2ff77347e56d27d0f0.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/20123869e38e7254ea40fdd7bd43f147f7d12d26.jpg[/img]

[h1]Lumencraft[/h1]

When devs from [b]2Dynamic Games[/b] started the playtests, we were convinced that approx. 200 people will check out the game during the two weeks of that phase. Well, there were [b]1312 participants[/b]. The feedback submitted by playtesters gave us a new perspective on the game. We knew that we chose the right project for publishing.

The [b]Lumencraft [/b]section of this Steam announcement will be the longest one, because the game’s still in Early Access and currently it’s a project no. 1 in our catalog. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1713810/Lumencraft/

After the first week of EA we reached the 20k copies milestone. None of us expected that this will happen so fast, so Kuba Wójcik came up with a meme idea.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/be9a75f964c9606a8e5a8f469a4aa6c4266c71f7.png[/img]

We won’t share how many copies were sold, but we can say that as the indie publishers - we’re satisfied. 😏

Today, exactly 3 months after the start of Early Access (which happened April 13th, 2022) we would like to thank everyone who wrote a review on Steam. The numbers speak for themselves. 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/34129bc80a88a4be9bad0b73d6afeac1e0ffac06.png[/img]

During the playtests, “2Ds” organized the [b]MAKE A MAP, WIN A PRIZE[/b] contest. 10 maps were published via Steam Workshop - 3 guys won Danger Scavenger and Driftland: The Magic Revival Steam keys. The ideas behind the contest were continued in the Maps Shootout series. When we’re writing these words there are [b]123 maps submitted to the Workshop[/b]. 🤯

Lots of them are truly pieces of art that reshape Lumencraft’s gameplay. The summary of all Maps Shootouts installments can be found in our Stories highlights on our Instagram.

What’s more, the game was shown at this year’s:
[b]- European Game Showcase during GDC;
- PAX East;
- Digital Dragons 🐲.[/b]

To this day, the [b]2Dynamic Games[/b] team is working closely with the game’s community. When [b]Early Access[/b] starts (after the playtests), the developers published:
- 3 hotfixes;
- 4 small updates;
- two major updates;
- and we’re pretty much sure we forgot about something. 💊

They added new weapons, buildings, monsters, maps and scenarios, textures, new UI, and fixed A LOT. Lumencraft is now more approachable to semi-casual players, but it does not collide with the hardcore players - there are extremely hard maps available to enjoy (or suffer a bit). 😈 

That’s all for today.
[h1]The second recap will be published at the end of 2022.[/h1]
Or maybe at the beginning of 2022?

Let’s see what happens. Great things are here, but also great things are yet to come.

Support the IndieDev!
Star Drifters 🚀

notes.title: We raise our glasses for the Tilt Five™ Glasses!
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Scavengers,[/h1]

We did not say our last words about the Danger Scavenger evolution. The question “how we can make our games even more immersive’ is a recurring thought inside the team – we often brainstorm about it, looking for the answers.

[b]Speaking about Danger Scavenger…[/b]
What could we do to elevate the gameplay of the game that takes place on the skyscraper rooftops? 

Then, the possibility of doing something together with the [url=https://www.tiltfive.com/]Tilt Five™[/url] team came to the table. A three-piece [url=https://www.tiltfive.com/]Tilt Five™ Holographic Gaming System [/url]seemed like a fantastic opportunity to bring our beloved roguelike, Danger Scavenger, to… a new level. The catchphrase "a new level of the 3D vibrant holographic environment" sounds intriguing and inspiring, right?

So, we realized that it’s time to make a dedicated DLC!

🚨Scavengers around the world!🚨
Our friends from 2Dynamic need help! So we came here to share with you some wonderful news about the upcoming game - Lumencraft💎. Now, let’s dive into it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36026814/37ce05172b001408718626d063cac1b632538c6e.png[/img]

AI 🤖 has outdone itself and created a portal to another dimension where humanity is struggling without electricity and light. What a wicked world it is!

Scavengers of that world fight with their enemies under the ground and collect crystals called Lumen. We have come into possession of tape from this strange dimension. Let’s listen!

MESSAGE FROM ANOTHER DIMENSION
* radio noise*
[i]Hello?... Hello? I’m recording this for whoever will find it. Hope things look better when you listen to me.

The year 2221. The planet's surface became uninhabitable over a century ago. Today, we - the remains of humanity - struggle to survive without electricity and light. Dreams of a better future died a long time ago, but a recently discovered mineral brought a spark of hope. Lumen - crystal of high energy potency can be the last chance for our struggling civilization. This mineral can drastically increase the odds of our survival. We have sent Scouts, our brave miners, under the ground. It’s almost impossible to survive there, but we don’t have much choice. A settlement was built near the estimated deposits of Lumen. It may sound pretty simple. Just dig and collect, but no one came back from there so far. New Scouts keep trying and I believe one of them will save us. If they succeed, I will record more tapes. If they fail… Well, there won’t be any energy to do so nor will there be anyone to listen to this. [/i]

[previewyoutube=KNvvPh2HlBI;full][/previewyoutube]

WHAT TO EXPECT
We have collected some data about what is on another side of the portal and it looks like these Scouts don’t have an easy task!

Lumencraft is a top-down action shooter with tower defense elements. Emerge into the fully destructible environment created with the original engine. Build, fight, drill and collect.

What’s more?
[list]
[*] Dynamical light and physics interactions with the fully destructible terrain. 💥
[*] Realistic simulations. 🌋
[*] Dread atmosphere created through the impactful sound design and a unique 2Dynamic lighting system. 💡
[*] Defending the underground settlement by direct combat and the use of diversified turrets.🔫

[*] Highly efficient and satisfying digging mechanics. 👌

notes.title: New Alert Scavengers! Support us!
notes.notes:
Dear Scavengers,
 
Sometimes you need to take one step back, in order to go two steps forward. Creating [b]Danger Scavenger[/b] we wanted to provide you the best roguelike game that we would like to play. 

Unfortunately, after the release, it turned out that almost half of the players have different expectations about our project. Not all of the decisions we made proved to be the right solution. Some of them made us closer to a [b]twin-stick shooter[/b], and we have a lot of players who don't like the system known from roguelike games. 

On the other hand, we have received a lot of [b]valuable feedbac[/b]k from our community, which showed us that our game can evolve. That's why we decided that [b]Danger Scavenger[/b] will be further developed with you - our great community, so we decided to switch to [b]Early Access[/b]. Now every player can influence how our game will eventually look like. It was not an easy decision - Danger Scavenger is a project of my life, which was previously created as [b]Turbo Island Purger[/b]. Cooperation with [b]Star Drifters[/b] allowed me to expand it with many new mechanics, which were not planned before. That is why we are very keen to provide you with a project that you will be happy.

We are entering [b]Early Access[/b] with a fully playable game. Our goal is to introduce an improvement and additional mechanics to satisfy two groups of players: roguelike fans and twin-stick shooter fans. Seemingly it is a difficult task, that's why we want to offer the possibility of choosing the game mode: roguelike or arcade (which is currently missing) and refining the balance of both modes. Also, it turned out that crafting, which we thought was a nice addition, is very important for players who from the very beginning of the game would like to be able to improve their items and weapons. That is why we would like to introduce frequent updates and be open to the ideas of our community, which honestly inspired us to move to early access.

[previewyoutube=X-BZ6Rfr1R8;full][/previewyoutube]

This will be short but intensive early access. The full version will be released no later than the console version before the end of 2020.
